title: Plant Manager
text:
At **QXO**, our **Branch Managers** are business leaders responsible for driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and talent development across their locations. This role goes far beyond day-to-day branch oversight. Branch Managers own the financial performance of the business, lead teams through growth and transformation, and partner closely with cross-functional leaders to deliver exceptional results for customers, employees, and shareholders. The ideal candidate combines strong business and financial acumen with exceptional leadership capability. They understand how to manage a P&L, optimize operations, build high-performing teams, execute strategic initiatives, and lead effectively through change in a fast-paced environment.

* Lead all aspects of branch performance, including sales, operations, customer service, inventory, safety, and profitability
* Own branch P&L performance and drive sustainable revenue growth, margin expansion, expense management, and return on investment
* Analyze financial, operational, and market performance data to identify opportunities, address risks, and make informed business decisions
* Develop and execute local business strategies aligned with company objectives and growth initiatives
* Build, coach, and develop high-performing teams while creating a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement
* Lead organizational change initiatives and help teams successfully navigate evolving business priorities, systems, and processes
* Partner closely with Sales, HR, EHS, FP&A, Credit, Supply Chain, Operations, and other Centers of Excellence to achieve business objectives
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with customers, vendors, and community stakeholders
* Drive operational excellence through disciplined execution, productivity improvements, inventory optimization, and process standardization
* Champion a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and operational standards
* Identify and develop future leaders through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and talent development initiatives
* Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and customer needs to uncover opportunities for growth and market share expansion

**What you'll earn:**

* 401(k) with employer match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* PTO, company holidays, and parental leave
* Paid training and certifications
* Legal assistance and identity protection
* Pet insurance
* Employee assistance program (EAP)

**QXO is an Equal Opportunity Employer**. It is the policy of the Company to comply with all employment laws and to afford equal employment opportunity to individuals in all aspects of employment, including in selection for job opportunities, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, protected veteran status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance submitting an application or would like to request an accommodation, please email us at careers@QXO.com to make a request.

QXO, Inc. (NYSE: QXO) is the largest publicly traded distributor of roofing, waterproofing, and related products, and the second largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials in North America. QXO is the fastest growing company in the $800 billion building products distribution industry and plans to become the tech-enabled leader by delivering best-in-class customer satisfaction and outsized returns for its shareholders. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenues within the next decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth.
